topic: 过去进行时与一般过去时的结合：when与while的巧妙用法
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来学习过去故事里的‘抓现行’组合——过去进行时（was/were + doing）与一般过去时（did）。你可以把过去进行时想象成一段‘长电影’，正在持续播放；而一般过去时就像是突然按下快门的‘短动作’，打断了之前的电影！连接这两个动作时，通常用 while 引导‘长动作’（如：While I was reading, the phone rang.），用 when 引导‘短瞬间’（如：I was sleeping when the alarm went off.）。记住口诀：长动作进行中，短动作插进来；while后常跟ing，when后短动作最常见！

questions.question: Leo ______ his bike in the park when it suddenly started to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：当天下雨时，Leo正在公园骑车。下雨（started to rain）是瞬间打断的动作，骑车是持续进行的动作，应用过去进行时 was riding。

questions.question: While my parents ______ dinner in the kitchen, the doorbell rang.
questions.explanation: while引导过去持续的动作，主语 parents 是复数，谓语动词用 were cooking。

questions.question: Sarah was doing her science homework when the lights ______ out.
questions.explanation: when在此引出突然发生的短暂动作（熄灯），应用一般过去时 went。

questions.question: What ______ you doing when the teacher walked into the classroom?
questions.explanation: 在过去某一时刻正在发生的动作，主语是 you，疑问句结构为 were you doing。

questions.question: While the boys ______ soccer, Emma was reading a novel under the tree.
questions.explanation: 两个过去动作同时在持续进行，用 while 连接两个过去进行时：were playing 与 was reading。

questions.question: The puppy was chasing a butterfly when it ______ into the small pond.
questions.explanation: 小狗追蝴蝶是长动作，掉进池塘是瞬间发生的动作，when 后面接一般过去时 fell。

questions.question: I ______ attention in math class when the teacher asked me a question.
questions.explanation: 老师提问时，我‘没有在集中注意力’，描述当时持续的状态，用过去进行时的否定形式 wasn't paying。

questions.question: Mia heard a strange noise while she ______ up the attic stairs.
questions.explanation: while 引导持续的动作，Mia 正在上阁楼楼梯时听到了响声，用 was walking。

questions.question: The students ______ quiet notes while Mr. Harrison was explaining the experiment.
questions.explanation: 老师在讲解实验的同时，学生们在记笔记，两个持续动作同时发生，均用过去进行时。

questions.question: Just as the plane was taking off, one passenger ______ sick.
questions.explanation: 飞机起飞这一过程正在进行时，一名乘客突然感到身体不适，felt 为短暂感官动作，用一般过去时。

questions.question: Who ______ to music when Grandma called you downstairs?
questions.explanation: 提问在奶奶呼唤的那一刻，谁‘正在听音乐’，用 was listening。

questions.question: Tim dropped his ice cream while he ______ to catch the bus.
questions.explanation: while 从句中表达当时正跑步追公交车这一持续动作，故用 was running。

questions.question: We ______ camping in the forest when a big thunderstorm hit the campsite.
questions.explanation: camping 是现在分词作表语或构成进行时。此处为过去进行时 were camping（正在露营）。

questions.question: Grandpa was pruning the rose bushes ______ the postman delivered a parcel.
questions.explanation: 后面跟随的是短暂的一般过去时动作 delivered，表示‘这时突然……’，选用连词 when。

questions.question: Lucas lost his watch ______ he was swimming in the lake.
questions.explanation: 从句 was swimming 是过去进行时，引导时间状语且表示持续动作，应用 while。

questions.question: The chef burned his finger while he ______ the hot soup.
questions.explanation: 厨师在尝汤的过程中烫到了手指。while 从句用过去进行时 was tasting。

questions.question: At 8 o'clock yesterday evening, we ______ a board game together as a family.
questions.explanation: yesterday evening 加上具体时间点 At 8 o'clock，表示过去某一具体时刻正在发生的动作，用 were playing。

questions.question: While the baby ______, her mother quietly folded the laundry.
questions.explanation: while 从句强调持续的背景动作，婴儿当时正在睡觉，用 was sleeping。

questions.question: Oliver ______ his ankle when he jumped down from the high wall.
questions.explanation: twist one's ankle（扭伤脚踝）是瞬间发生的动作，跳下时扭到了，主句应用一般过去时 twisted。

questions.question: What ______ you and Kevin discussing when I entered the library?
questions.explanation: 主语是 you and Kevin（两个人，复数），且为过去进行时，助动词选用 were。

questions.question: The wind was blowing fiercely, and dry leaves ______ across the yard.
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列的过去背景动作，主语 dry leaves 是复数，故选 were flying。

questions.question: Lily found an old gold coin while she ______ flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 在花园种花是一个持续动作，在此过程中找到了硬币，while 后用 was planting。

questions.question: I saw a shooting star while I ______ up at the night sky.
questions.explanation: while 引导持续的动作，主语是 I，过去进行时为 was gazing。

questions.question: They ______ attention, so they didn't hear what the coach said.
questions.explanation: 教练说话时他们‘正处于没有集中注意力的状态’，强调当时持续的状态，故用 weren't paying。

questions.question: Was Henry drawing a comic strip when you ______ his bedroom?
questions.explanation: when 引导突然发生的打断性动作（进入卧室），用一般过去时 entered。

questions.question: The birds were singing cheerfully ______ the sun came up over the mountains.
questions.explanation: 太阳升起（came up）作为特定时间点，前面用 when 引导时间状语从句。

questions.question: While the artist ______ the portrait, his model fell asleep.
questions.explanation: 画肖像是一个持续动作，模特在作画过程中睡着了。while 后接过去进行时 was painting。

questions.question: Chloe ______ her keys when she was taking her coat out of her locker.
questions.explanation: 掉落钥匙是一瞬间完成的动作，不能用进行时，主句用一般过去时 dropped。

questions.question: Why ______ you wearing your raincoat yesterday morning when it was bright and sunny?
questions.explanation: wearing 是现在分词，主语为 you，时间是 yesterday morning，过去进行时的疑问句用 were。

questions.question: While my sister ______ violin upstairs, I was practicing the piano downstairs.
questions.explanation: 两个长动作在过去同一时间段平行发生，主句和从句都使用过去进行时，故选 was playing。
